sections.title: "Transfer" and "revocable transfer" defined.
sections.text_before_clauses: For the purposes of sections 96 and 97, and this section,—

clauses.text: "transfer" includes any settlement, trust, covenant, agreement or arrangement;

clauses.text_before_sub_clauses: a transfer shall be deemed to be revocable, if—

sub_clauses.text: it contains any provision for the direct or indirect re-transfer of the whole or any part of the income or assets to the transferor; or
it, in any way, gives the transferor a right to re-assume power directly or indirectly over the whole or any part of the income or assets.
